description: MtaStsConfig.enabled exists in config.rs but main.rs never reads it to conditionally create an MtaStsEnforcer. Operators who set mta_sts.enabled = true in their config file will see no effect — the enforcer is never created, initialized, or passed to any delivery path. This is a silent misconfiguration footgun: the operator believes MTA-STS is enabled but delivery proceeds unenfored.
title: mta_sts.enabled config flag has no effect — enforcer never created from it
